# A02-S60: Residency terms

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…] 

Haha, thanks for that! In philosophical circles we also agree that Hendricks
is a logicist foghorn, so I’m happy to push him off the pedestal.

Now we shall see if I manage to sneak the public debate in through the back door. The first
hurdle is that [████] balked at the public events outside of the 
budget, which would have to create activity at the center. Apparently, there is
talk about 25.000 in a residency program that supports ‘my’ artwork. I have
suggested saying thanks for that, noting that they will then miss out on a good offer,
and using all the money to play with chatbot and policy development in a
digital residency (which I can do at little cost, plus then I could
apply for art funding on that). Then I can formulate everything myself, which must
be preferable, and if it turns out a success we will see if they dare
profit from it and take the debate. I’ll probably have to prepare some strategies
to steer it in another direction if so.

[…]
